finalists.label: Ectopic Pregnancy
finalists.why: It has the most specific evidence, including a 1-day history of epigastric pain radiating to the lower abdomen, β-hCG level of 523 IU/L, empty uterus with normal endometrial thickness, and previous cesarean section.

frontier_selector.why: The combination of a positive β-hCG level, empty uterine cavity on ultrasound, and the patient's symptoms decided the final comparison in favor of Ectopic Pregnancy.
